content: 1. Focus on consuming minimally processed carbohydrates that are rich in nutrients, with an emphasis on high-fiber options providing at least 14 grams of fiber per 1,000 kilocalories. 2. Restrict the intake of sugar-sweetened beverages and promote the consumption of water or low-calorie alternatives to help maintain glycemic control and support cardiovascular health. 3. Offer education on the effects of carbohydrate consumption, customized to meet individual needs, to facilitate accurate and effective insulin dosing. 4. For individuals using insulin, provide guidance on maintaining consistent timing of carbohydrate intake to minimize the risk of hypoglycemia.
